sheets.title: MECHANICAL LEGEND, ABBREVIATIONS AND NOTES
sheets.reading_notes: Legend and general notes sheet. Confirms project is 'ORF PARKING ADMINISTRATION BUILDING' at '2200 NORVIEW AVE, NORFOLK, VA'. Date 07/07/2025. Labeled as '65% SUBMITTAL 10/17/2025'. Proj. No. 25-F-02. Designer: Andre + Marquez Architects. Client: Norfolk Airport Authority. Sheet 1 of 4 (but only 3 pages in PDF — sheet 4 likely M-103 or M-schedule not included). HVAC systems vocabulary: AHU, VAV, MSO (Mini-Split Outdoor), MSI (Mini-Split Indoor), EF (Exhaust Fan), ACCU (Condensing Unit). Note specifies flexible duct runs shall not exceed 5 feet — standard SMACNA practice. General note item 12 requires compliance with municipal, state, federal codes, NFPA, SMACNA.

sheets.title: FIRST FLOOR PLAN — DUCTWORK
sheets.reading_notes: Single-story building floor plan showing HVAC ductwork layout. Central AHU-1 with VAV boxes (VAV-1 through VAV-6 visible) serving admin suite, offices, break room, parking operations, sign storage, and corridor zones. IT Closet served by MSI-1/MSO-1 mini-split. MEP room (L1019) served by MSI-2/MSO-2 mini-split and ACCU-1 condensing unit. EF-1 exhaust fan visible serving restroom/toilet areas. L-1 possibly a louver. Two ACOU units shown — possibly VAV with electric heat. Main supply duct is 24x16 inches on interior spine, branching to zones. Ductwork is clearly all new construction. Scale 1/8' = 1'-0'. Date 07/07/2025, submittal stamp 65% 10/17/2025. Building footprint confirms roughly 94'-8' x 52'-6' from concept layout = ~4,970 SF exterior but 3,895 SF net — consistent with wall thickness and interstitial areas. One story.

sheets.title: FIRST FLOOR PLAN — PIPING
sheets.reading_notes: Hydronic/refrigerant piping plan. Shows mini-split refrigerant lines (3/8' refrigerant suction and 1/4' liquid lines) from IT closet MSI-1 to MSO-1 unit and MEP room MSI-2 to MSO-2. Built-up AHU-1 with electric heat. Indicates condensate drain piping. Notes reference 'BUILT-UP AHU ELECTRIC HEAT DETAIL' — AHU-1 is an electric-heat air handler, not gas or hot water. Sheet largely blank on plan drawing (appears reduced/very faint in render). Notes column matches M-101. Sheet is M-102 of 4.

sheets.title: ELECTRICAL SYMBOLS, LEGEND, ABBREVIATIONS AND NOTES
sheets.reading_notes: Electrical legend, lighting fixture schedule, and general notes. Confirms project identity. Date 07/07/2025. 65% SUBMITTAL 10/17/2025. Proj. No. 25-F-02. IMPORTANT: Arc flash hazard warning label references UFC 3-560-01 — this is a US Department of Defense Unified Facilities Criteria document for arc flash protection. Presence suggests either this is a DoD-controlled facility or the NAA has adopted UFC standards, OR the A-E team routinely uses UFC reference for arc flash regardless of client. NAA is a regional authority, not federal DoD, but airports under TSA jurisdiction sometimes reference UFC. Flag for human review. Lighting fixture schedule lists Lithonia Lighting products throughout — LED, MVOLT fixtures ranging from 3,000 to 6,000 lumens. Types include recessed, surface, and pole-mounted (area/site lighting). Emergency battery pack fixtures included. Emergency LED unit (LQM) at .71W — likely exit sign type.

sheets.title: FLOOR PLAN — LIGHTING
sheets.reading_notes: Interior lighting floor plan. Shows panelboards PB-36, PB-38, PB-40 serving different zones of the building. All lighting fixture types from schedule visible distributed across rooms. LED recessed fixtures in offices and admin suite; surface-mounted in break room and storage; downlights in corridor. Emergency/exit lighting units at entrance and egress paths. Single-story plan matches M-101 footprint exactly. Occupancy sensor switches (So) visible at office doorways. Scale 1/4' = 1'-0'. Panelboard PB-40 in northeast corner, PB-38 mid-building, PB-36 in admin suite area — likely separate panels for different portions/circuits.

sheets.title: ELECTRICAL SITE LIGHTING PLAN
sheets.reading_notes: Site lighting plan showing parking lot and access road context. Building shown at center of site within parking structure environment — consistent with 'Parking Administration Building' at ORF. Pole-mounted site lights (Type A, per fixture schedule: DSX2 LED P1 40K 70CR TZM MVOLT) distributed around site. Site shows surface parking adjacent to building. Scale 1' = 20'-0'. New work notes placeholder text (XXXXXX) suggesting this sheet may be incomplete at 65% stage.

sheets.title: PLUMBING LEGEND, ABBREVIATIONS AND NOTES
sheets.reading_notes: Plumbing legend and equipment schedules. Date 07/07/2025. 65% SUBMITTAL 10/17/2025. Proj. No. 25-F-02. PLUMBING FIXTURE CONNECTION SCHEDULE: P-1 Flush Valve Water Closet (HC), P-2 Flush Valve Water Closet, P-3 Lavatory, P-4 Lavatory, P-5 2-Compartment Kitchen Sink, P-6 Ice Maker Connection Box, P-7 Drinking Fountain (Bi-Level), P-8 Flush Valve Urinal, P-9 Mop Sink. ELECTRIC WATER HEATER SCHEDULE: EWH-1 — 30 GAL, 4,500W, 208V/3PH/60Hz, 140°F HW temp. PUMP SCHEDULE: RCP-1 — recirculation pump, Bell & Gossett ECOICIRC XL, 3 GPM, 15 FT head, 208V/1PH. THERMOSTATIC MIXING VALVE: TMV-1 — master, mechanical room, high-low flow 26/3 GPM, 140°F in / 105°F out. BACKFLOW PREVENTER: BFP-1 — 2' RZBP domestic CW supply. Plumbing scope confirms domestic cold and hot water, sanitary/DWV, with recirculation. No natural gas plumbing shown (all electric heat). Handicap accessible fixtures per ADA/ABAAG.

sheets.title: FIRST FLOOR PLAN — DOMESTIC WATER
sheets.reading_notes: Domestic water piping plan. Cold water (CW) main entering building at 2-1/2' pipe, distributing to men's/women's restrooms, break room (kitchen sink, ice maker, drinking fountain), mechanical room (EWH-1, TMV-1, BFP-1, RCP-1). Hot water (HW) and hot water return (HWR) distribution visible. Wall hydrants (WH) at multiple exterior locations. Single-story. Restrooms in center of building per concept layout match. Balancing valve to break room set at 3 GPM per note. No sanitary/DWV plan shown in this 65% submittal package (separate sheet likely).
